questions.explanation: To find the probability of getting at least one head in three coin tosses, we can use the complement rule. The complement of "at least one head" is "no heads," i.e., getting all tails. The probability of getting tails in a single toss is \( \frac{1}{2} \), so the probability of getting tails in all three tosses is \( \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 \).
